phoneMirror.title: Phone Mirror
phoneMirror.description: Stream live AI responses from your desktop to a phone browser on the same network. Useful when you're sharing your screen and want the AI output kept off the shared display.
phoneMirror.lanOnHint: Phones on the same WiFi can connect with the pairing token.
phoneMirror.lanOffHint: Loopback only — only this computer can connect (use SSH tunnel for remote access).
phoneMirror.lanWarning: Anyone on this network with the pairing URL can read your AI responses. Use only on trusted networks. Rotate the token below if you suspect the URL was shared.
phoneMirror.noLanIpWarning: LAN access is on, but no Wi-Fi or Ethernet IP was detected. Connect this {{device}} to the same Wi-Fi as your phone (VPN tunnels and virtual interfaces don't count). If you've connected, also confirm <0>{{firewallPath}}</0> is allowing incoming connections for this app.
phoneMirror.scanHintLanOn: Open the camera app and point at the code.
phoneMirror.scanHintLanOff: LAN access is off. Turn it on, or open the URL on this computer.
phoneMirror.emptyHint: Turn on Phone Mirror to generate a pairing URL and QR code.
phoneMirror.privacyNote: Phone Mirror runs entirely on your local network. No traffic leaves your machine — the bridge serves an HTML page and a WebSocket directly to your phone, gated by a per-session pairing token.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: 24-hour refund window — voucher purchases are final sale
refund.headsUp: <0>A quick heads-up:</0> Natively is built and maintained by a single developer and integrates a lot of third-party services — AI providers, transcription engines, search APIs, payments, OS-level audio & screen capture. That gives the app a lot of capability, but the surface area is wider than a typical closed-source product, and once in a while something may not behave exactly as expected. If you run into something like that, please <1>report it</1> rather than disputing the charge — we read every report and fixes typically land in the next update.
refund.finalSale: Purchases made with a coupon, voucher, referral credit, or limited-time offer are <0>final sale</0> and not eligible for refund.
refund.cancel: To cancel your subscription, log in to the <0>customer portal</0> to manage or cancel your plan.
refund.seeFull: For everything else — the 24-hour refund window, subscription handling, taxes & fees, and your local consumer rights — please see our full <0>Refund Policy</0>. To request a refund or ask a question, email <1></1>.
refund.personalNote: <0>A personal note:</0> Natively is built, maintained, and supported entirely by one person — in their free time. Email replies may take a few days, and weekends (Sat & Sun) are offline. Your patience is genuinely appreciated.
